title: Your Old Job's 401k Is Bleeding You $116,000
hook: When you left that job, you forgot something — and that abandoned 401k is quietly leaking six figures in fees you're still paying.
angle: Orphaned 401k accounts trap former employees in high-fee fund options because plan negotiating power vanishes when you leave. With $1.65 trillion sitting in abandoned accounts and 24 million people affected, this is a massive hidden wealth drain that takes 15 minutes to fix.
audience: Job-hoppers, career changers, anyone who's ever switched employers without rolling over their 401k
key_numbers: $1.65 trillion — total abandoned 401k assets in America
0.8% — extra annual fee charged to former employees vs. active employees
$116,000 — excess fees paid on a $150K balance over 20 years vs. an IRA rollover
15 minutes — average time to complete a direct rollover
